title: Men's 1500m World Rankings: October 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's 1500m (Mile–2000m–Mile Road) event ranking as of 27 October 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. Short-track performances are included; this is a dated top-ten snapshot, not the complete athlete population. Source places 8 and 9 both score 1342; the site displays equal-value ties.

source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-11-04 against the original official HTML opened in the browser and retrieved directly (HTTP 200). Compared all ten names, countries, source places 1–10, ranking points and the 27 October 2026 reference date. IOC codes mapped to ISO-2: AUS/AU, USA/US, FRA/FR, KEN/KE, POR/PT, GBR/GB. Scope is 1500m (Mile-2000m-Mile Road), including short-track performances where indicated by the source. Source places 8 and 9 have equal 1342 points; the UI groups equal values as ties.
